description: React component for displaying and editing guardrail information in a dashboard, including overview and settings tabs, with support for PII configuration, content filtering, provider-specific parameters, and guardrail updates.

methods.name: fetchGuardrailInfo
methods.description: Fetches guardrail data and initializes PII configuration state.

methods.name: fetchGuardrailUISettings
methods.description: Fetches UI settings related to guardrails.

methods.name: resetToolPermissionEditor
methods.description: Resets the tool permission configuration to match guardrail data.

methods.name: handleToolPermissionConfigChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the tool permission configuration.

methods.name: handlePiiEntitySelect
methods.description: Toggles selection of a PII entity.

methods.name: handlePiiActionSelect
methods.description: Sets the action for a specific PII entity.

methods.name: handleGuardrailUpdate
methods.description: Prepares and sends updated guardrail data to backend.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies specified text to clipboard and manages UI feedback.
